Cao.title: CAO
Cao.description: A read-only reference projection of one collective labour agreement (collectieve arbeidsovereenkomst) from the maintained CAO corpus (lib/Standards/cao/{caoId}.json), seeded idempotently from CaoRegistry by NlCaoChecks::seedObjects() (cao-library). The corpus is the single authoring source; these objects are a derived display surface for the read-only Caos reference page and MUST NOT be hand-edited (allowCreate:false on the manifest pages). An EmploymentContract references a CAO by its caoId, not by this object's UUID.

caoId.title: CAO id
caoId.description: The stable corpus id (e.g. cao-metaal-techniek). The natural key the seed upserts on and the value an EmploymentContract.cao references.

version.title: Version
version.description: The CAO revision this projection captures (e.g. '2025-2026').

effectiveDate.title: Effective date
effectiveDate.description: ISO date the revision took effect.

payScales.title: Pay scales
payScales.description: Map of schaal -> minimum maandloon in integer cents. Enforced by nl-cao-minimumloon-schaal only when payScalesVerified is true.

payScalesVerified.title: Pay scales verified
payScalesVerified.description: Whether the payScales figures are confirmed against the official CAO-tekst. When false the scales are advisory (placeholder) and raise no mandatory violation.

allowances.title: Allowances
allowances.description: Map of standard CAO allowances (e.g. ploegentoeslag). Display-only in this MVP; not yet computed into net pay.

leaveEntitlement.title: Leave entitlement
leaveEntitlement.description: Map of vakantiedagenWettelijk + vakantiedagenBovenwettelijk (full-time day counts). Enforced by nl-cao-verlof-minimum only when leaveEntitlementVerified is true.

leaveEntitlementVerified.title: Leave entitlement verified
leaveEntitlementVerified.description: Whether the leaveEntitlement figures are confirmed against the official CAO-tekst. When false the entitlement is advisory (placeholder) and raises no mandatory violation.

workingTime.title: Working time
workingTime.description: Map of working-time norms (e.g. fulltimeHoursPerWeek). Informational/display-only — not read by any check.

source.title: Source
source.description: Human-readable summary of the CAO's primary-source citations (basedOn).
